name: Soothing Throwarm
description: Sense through the hand on the arm how much twist the skeins hold before the draw begins.

name: Alert Frameside
description: Rap the base of the arm into the skein bundle with a mallet so it sits true between the two skeins.

name: Tenderhearted Torsion
description: Count the beats of the arm's rise after release to learn its cycle by ear.

name: Resolute Axlepin
description: Wrap the stop beam in hide and rope so the blow of the arm spreads along its length.

name: Savage Armcup
description: Feed qi into the twisted skeins as the arm is drawn so the release hurls the stone harder.

name: Winchswat
description: Time a qi-sharpened lanyard pull to the peak of skein tension for a clean and hard throw.

name: Armcupcordial
description: Catch the swinging cup as it falls back and steady it with a braced forearm for the next stone.

name: Ducking Arcflight
description: Roll the next stone to the loader's boot while the arm is still rising so no step is lost.

name: Stalwart Skein
description: Tap the pawl back into its tooth with the heel of the hand the moment the winders pause.

name: Rallying Winchdrum
description: Pass the crank from one pair of winders to the next without letting the rope slip a tooth.

name: Cooling Stoneload
description: Lift the stone into the cup with qi through the legs so a heavy shot goes in at one count.

name: Quickening Frameside
description: Link crank and relatch and loading into one counted rhythm so each hand moves as the last finishes.

name: Armcuplinen
description: Hug a heavy shot against the chest and lift with the legs to bring it to the cup lip.

name: Quickening Basecradle
description: Slide the stone up a greased plank into the cup lip with two handlers pushing in turns.

name: Armcuptonic
description: Strap the heavy stone into the cup with a looped band that parts when the arm snaps up.

name: Winchtonic
description: Hold the arm angle low for a flat heavy throw and read how the frame rides under load.

name: Quickening Releasepin
description: Listen for the groan of the frame beams under a heavy draw and call a halt on a crack.

name: Doughty Stonefall
description: Press qi into the weighted cup so a heavy stone leaves the arm with extra force behind it.

name: Acrid Winchdrum
description: Loose a heavy stone on a steep qi-driven arc so it falls hard on the marked ground.

name: Draught Bombardment
description: Drag a light catapult by its trail ropes in step with the crew over broken ground.

name: Sound Skein
description: Lock both wheels with a pin and a wedge in the time of two breaths.

name: Claywinch
description: Crouch behind the frame beam when enemy fire lands near the crew.

name: Knitting Axlepin
description: Count off the crew by name after every move so no hand is left behind the line.

name: Grit Throwarm
description: Haul on the trail rope with two others to bring the frame about to a new bearing.

name: Winchswerve
description: Send qi through the hauling arms so a crew of three can turn a loaded frame at a run.

name: Sleetwinch
description: Pair a quick qi-aided draw with an immediate release to put a stone in the air as the crew sets.

name: Skeincordial
description: Fill a hide sack with fist-sized gravel and bind it so it breaks open in flight.

name: Releasepin Bandage
description: Seat the gravel sack in the cup with its seam up so the bag tears cleanly on release.

name: Candorwinch
description: Peg the ground where the scatter should fall and read it again after every shot.

name: Comet Ballistic
description: Load three fist stones loosely in the cup and let the arm scatter them over a short stretch.

name: Purpose Stoneload
description: Pinch the cup pouch into a shallow pocket that holds a spread of small stones.

name: Gap Armcup
description: Watch how the stones part in the air and note which pocket shape spreads them widest.

name: Harsh Unwind
description: Pop the gravel sack with a pulse of qi at the arm's peak so the load flies out in a wide shower.

name: Unwindslap
description: Throw a mixed load of small stones with qi behind each so they rattle down across a broad patch.

name: Poise Torsion
description: Lay a chain of linked rods in a straight line from frame to target to fix the bearing.

name: Humarmcup
description: Count the links from frame to the impact mark to learn how far a shot flew.

name: Sprout Stoneload
description: Tie a knotted cord at each marked shot distance and keep it hung on the frame.

name: Basecradle Cordial
description: Wedge the bed to match a rise or fall in the ground before the first shot.

name: Lunar Frameside
description: Sight along a hung plumb line to catch whether the frame has leaned since the last shot.

name: Throwarm Cordial
description: Pair the thud of the landing stone with its mark in the ground to keep the count honest.

name: Gap Axlepin
description: Thread a thin line of qi along the rod chain to hold the aim steady through a long wind.

name: Draught Torque
description: Loose stones one after another and walk each impact along the chain toward the target mark.

name: Skeinlinen
description: Dig a shallow pad in firm ground and line it with flat stones for the frame to stand on.

name: Sproutwinch
description: Cut shallow pits under the wheels so the frame sinks level and cannot roll.

name: Sprigarmcup
description: Drive an iron spike behind the trail so recoil pushes against earth and not against the wheels.

name: Purpose Winchdrum
description: Haul lashing cords across the frame in a cross pattern and knot them off with one pull.

name: Skein Bandage
description: Push the empty frame hard from the side to find any play before the first draw.

name: Armcup Hasp
description: Stretch a wet hide across the rope bundle to guard it from sparks and rain.

name: Sprig Basecradle
description: Send qi down through the trail and into the ground so the frame stays rooted under a hard throw.

name: Patient Axlepin
description: Raise the frame from its carry bars and seat it level in one qi-aided heave.

name: Shard Ballistic
description: Loose a stone from the seated mount and use the stable frame to hold the same arc each time.

name: Sproutarmcup
description: Bring the arm down to the latch and catch it with the pawl in one steady pull.

name: Sure Stoneload
description: Wipe the hands dry before every crank to keep the handles from slipping.

name: Poiseskein
description: Wind slack rope back on the drum in long even sweeps without stopping for each coil.

name: Torsion Poultice
description: Shake the empty cup once to drop grit that would foul the next stone.

name: Dawnwinch
description: Lift the pawl with the heel of the hand on the count so release and lowering stay linked.

name: Grit Arcflight
description: Step back from the swinging arm in two quick paces to clear its path.

name: Kindly Winchdrum
description: Breathe on a shared count so the crew draws together and finishes together.

name: Acrid Arcflight
description: Cycle qi through the crew's arms to drive winding and loading and release faster than rest allows.

name: Poise Basecradle
description: Pass qi hand to hand along the crank crew so the last winder is as fresh as the first.

name: Brawn Unwind
description: Step in to take a faltering winder's place at the crank in the beat before the rope slackens.
